title: Arthroscopic Lavage and Arthroscopic Debridement for the Osteoarthritic Knee
benefit_category: Incident to a physician's professional Service, Inpatient Hospital Services, Physicians' Services
revision_history: <p> 6/2004 - Arthroscopic lavage alone for treatment of osteoarthritis of knee, and arthroscopic debridement for presentation of knee pain only or arthroscopic debridement and lavage with or without debridement for patients with severe osteoarthritis of knee are noncovered. All other indications of debridement for subpopulation of patients without severe osteoarthritis of knee who present with symptoms other than pain alone remain at contractor discretion. Effective date 6/11/04. Implementation date 7/11/04. (<a href="https://www.cms.gov/Regulations-and-Guidance/Guidance/Transmittals/Downloads/R14NCD.pdf">TN 14</a>) (CR 3281)</p>
